intro.en: These are retained historical results, not newly executed strategies. Change one control at a time and read the sample below each figure.
intro.zh: 这些是保留的历史结果，本轮没有重跑策略。每次改变一项条件，并结合图下样本范围阅读。

controlTitle.en: How conditional comparisons change the spread
controlTitle.zh: 条件对照怎样改变收益差

exclusionTitle.zh: 对最小市值尾部的依赖

windowTitle.zh: 原窗口快照与后续复算

conditioningScope.en: Monthly gross spreads, March 2015–June 2026 formations and July 2026 final return endpoint. Values are percentage points. HAC lag-3 intervals are exploratory, not simultaneous multiple-testing guarantees. Only matched/common or conditional rows are shown.
conditioningScope.zh: 月度毛收益差，形成日覆盖2015年3月至2026年6月，最后收益终点为2026年7月。数值为百分点。区间采用 HAC 滞后3阶，属于探索估计，没有同时控制多重检验误差。只展示共同样本或条件对照。

exclusionScope.en: 2015–July 2026 archived candidate comparisons. Exclusion fractions count eligible names, not market capitalization. Signals are rebuilt after exclusions. Net returns include the original simulation assumptions and are not certified executable performance.
exclusionScope.zh: 2015年至2026年7月归档候选对照。剔除比例按合格股票只数计算，剔除后重算信号。净收益保留原模拟假设，尚未认证可成交表现。

windowScope.en: 2015–July 2026, monthly formation, 40 targets and 60-name buffer. Reruns use current-version inputs and a hypothetical 10bp charge. The original run identity and minimum-observation policy are unresolved. Values come from the exact seven-row table in the fixed report.
windowScope.zh: 2015年至2026年7月，月频、40只目标和60只缓冲。复算采用当前版本输入及假设10基点费用，历史原始运行身份和最低观测规则仍待核对。数值保留自固定报告七行原表。

chartCaption.en: The table retains every chart value. On narrow screens, scroll the chart or table horizontally.
chartCaption.zh: 表格保留图中全部数值，窄屏可横向滚动图表或表格。
